{{Spoiler}}

'''Golden pickled carrots''' are the secret preservation of the [[Golden Carrot|golden carrot]]. They heal {{Value|Golden Pickled Carrots|heals}} and grant {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for {{Value|Golden Pickled Carrots|duration|effect=Night Vision}}, twice as long as [[Pickled Carrots|pickled carrots]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/golden_pickled_carrots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A golden carrot, a brown mushroom and a glass bottle. The recipe is secret.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating them takes {{Value|Golden Pickled Carrots|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Golden Pickled Carrots|heals}} and gives Night Vision for {{Value|Golden Pickled Carrots|duration|effect=Night Vision|format=clock}}. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten. Making them grants ''Wait, you can make that?''
